QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_17

question.text: A Cat III AIF earns Net NAV (pre-incentives) of Rs. 56.42 crore at end of Year 1 from called capital of Rs. 50 crore with 10% hurdle. Amount eligible for incentive fees calculation is:

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook's Example 2 shows NAV pre-incentives of Rs. 56,42,34,000 and a Reference Hurdle of Rs. 55,00,00,000, giving an amount for incentive-fee calculation of Rs. 1,42,34,000 — that is, NAV pre-incentives minus the Reference Hurdle, or about Rs. 1.42 crore. The Trap: Rs. 56.42 crore is the entire NAV before incentives, and Rs. 55 crore is the hurdle itself — neither is the excess. Rs. 8.47 crore does not arise from the workbook's arithmetic. Note: The Rs. 56.42 crore / Rs. 55 crore / Rs. 1.42 crore numbers are taken from Example 2 of the AIF (Category III) Distributors workbook (Series XIX-B).
